name: Half-Ogre (Far Distant Future Publishing)
body:
When ogres breed with smaller humanoids, the results are usually the deformed creatures known as ogrekin. However, sometimes these unions produce half-ogres who combine the strength of their ogre parent and the cunning of the small folk without appreciable disadvantages.

Ability Scores You gain +4 Str, –2 Int, –2 Cha. This trait replaces fire acclimated, half-giant psionics, and survivor, and alters ability scores.
Languages You begin play speaking Common. If you have a high Intelligence score, you can choose from any of the following languages: Draconic, Giant, Goblin, and Orc. This trait alters languages.
Natural Armor Traits You have tough, resilient skin that provides a +1 natural armor bonus. This trait replaces naturally psionic.
Half-Oni

These rare half-giants are descended from ogre magi or other oni who bred with half-giants or humans. Their children were not possessed of oni spirits, but neither were they completely mundane. Forming their own communities, they now breed true as a species.

Ability Scores You gain +2 Str, +2 Cha, –2 Dex. This trait alters ability scores.
Oni Magic If you have a Charisma score of 12 or higher, you can use the following spell-like abilities: 1/day—alter self and vanish. You use your character level as the caster level, and Charisma is your casting ability. This trait replaces fire acclimated, half-giant psionics, and psionic aptitude.
Resistant Traits You gain a +2 species bonus on saving throws against mind-affecting effects and poison. This trait replaces naturally psionic.
Alternate Species Traits
Cold Acclimated You are descended from giants of glaciers and tundra rather than those of deserts, volcanoes, and jungles. You receive a +2 species bonus on saving throws against all spells and effects with the cold descriptor. This trait replaces fire acclimated.
Storm Acclimated Traits You are descended from giants of high mountain peaks and cloud kingdoms. You receive a +2 species bonus on saving throws against all spells and effects with the electricity. This trait replaces fire acclimated.

Awesome Ancestries: Variant Species Options, Vol. 2 – Mortals of the Multiverse. © 2025, Far Distant Future Publishing; Author: Bryan Mangum
